title: Standup
description: What changed since you last looked, as three lists: finished, newly opened, and stuck. A reader who asks how things are going twice in one afternoon is asking for a DELTA, and a page that restates the whole board answers a different question. The split comes from the work fold's item states beside each worker's own last status, and the moment feed comes from the timeline fold, so both halves are the record's. One line is the mate's own headline, which no fold writes, and the page marks it as written.

upkeep.means: one line summing up what finished, opened or got stuck since the last look
upkeep.when: once per round, and whenever something finishes, opens or gets stuck
upkeep.how: write one plain sentence; write it with dashboard_write; call dashboard_fields first for its shape
